deals.title: Free entry to New York museums with your NYU ID
deals.eligibility: NYU students with a valid NYU ID card.
deals.howToGet: Show your NYU ID at the Brooklyn Museum, El Museo del Barrio, the Frick Collection and others on NYU's list. MoMA and MoMA PS1: book online and choose 'Free College - NYU'. Whitney: book with promo code NYU1. Museum of the City of New York: reserve online with the NYU code, plus one guest. The New Museum is temporarily closed.
deals.sourceQuote: NYU's Museum Gateway gives students free admission to some of New York City's best cultural institutions. Enjoy free museums simply by showing your NYU ID Card at the locations listed below.
